---
title: "About OTTO Lab"
---

OTTO Lab (Observational Target Trial Operations) uses causal inference to ask and answer questions in psychological science. We are interested in real-world problems.

We are based in the [School of Psychological Sciences](https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/psyc) at Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington, We also work closly with the [Centre for Applied Cross-Cultural Research (CACR)](https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/cacr).

We maintain [Places Map](https://religionmap.org/), open research infrastructure for mapping places of worship and supporting cross-cultural policy research. The underlying codebase is available at [github.com/go-bayes/places-of-worship](https://github.com/go-bayes/places-of-worship).
